english: Use have/has + past participle for experience or a past action connected to now. Avoid a finished-time word such as yesterday.
persian: حال کامل برای تجربه یا کاری در گذشته است که به الان ربط دارد. با زمان تمام‌شده‌ای مثل yesterday نمی‌آید.
examples: I have worked with Java for two years.

english: Use the first conditional for a realistic future result: if + present, will + base verb.
persian: شرطی نوع اول برای نتیجه محتمل آینده است: if + حال ساده، will + فعل ساده.
examples: If the flight is delayed, I will call you.
If I finish early, I will join the meeting.

mistakes.learner: If it will rain, we will stay home.
mistakes.corrected: If it rains, we will stay home.

english: Use who for people, which for things, and that for either in defining relative clauses.
persian: در جمله‌واره موصولی، who برای شخص، which برای چیز و that برای هر دو به‌کار می‌رود.
examples: I need a place that allows pets.
She is the manager who interviewed me.

english: Use be + past participle when the action or result matters more than the person doing it.
persian: وقتی عمل یا نتیجه مهم‌تر از انجام‌دهنده است از be + قسمت سوم فعل استفاده کن.

english: When reporting earlier speech, the tense often moves back: am/is becomes was, will becomes would.
persian: در نقل قول غیرمستقیمِ گفته‌ی قبلی، زمان فعل معمولاً یک مرحله به گذشته می‌رود.
examples: He told me he would call.

mistakes.learner: She said me she is busy.
mistakes.corrected: She told me she was busy.

english: Learn common adjective and verb combinations as chunks: interested in, responsible for, depend on, apply for.
persian: حرف اضافه را همراه کلمه یاد بگیر: interested in، responsible for، depend on و apply for.
examples: I am responsible for the API.
